params.prompt: A young man standing still at the far left edge of a rain-slick city street at night, hands in pockets, calm and unhurried, seen from a distance. The right side of the frame is deep empty darkness with only faint blurred traffic light streaks far in the background and one clean mint-green reflection on the wet asphalt. A protective, grounded mood of deliberately choosing to wait. Vertical cinematic editorial photograph, shot on 35mm, shallow depth of field, moody dark graphite base tones with electric blue and a distinct mint-green accent light. Gen Z energy, real person, natural skin, candid and unposed, premium fashion-campaign quality. CRITICAL COMPOSITION RULE: the human subject must be pushed fully into the far LEFT edge of the frame, occupying at most the left third. The entire right two-thirds and the whole center of the frame must be clean, dark, uncluttered empty negative space with no subject and no busy detail, reserved for a phone mockup overlay. Absolutely no text, no letters, no words, no watermarks, no logos, no brand marks, no screens, no phone visible in frame.
